item.title: Tsukuba Space Center: Japan's Gateway to Space — Guide
item.description: Tsukuba Space Center, operated by JAXA (the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency), is the country’s primary space development facility and one of the highlights of Tsukuba’s broader identity as a planned ‘science city.’ The centre’s free exhibition hall displays a full-size H-II rocket, mock-ups of the International Space Station’s Japanese Kibo module, satellite models and artefacts from Japan’s space history, while guided tours (some requiring advance reservation) take visitors past the mission control room used for real satellite and ISS operations.

item.title: Ibaraki Family Trip: Seaside Park, Space Center & Pacific Coast
item.description: Ibaraki Prefecture is one of the most rewarding family destinations in the Kanto region — and one of the least crowded. While Tokyo families pour into Disneyland and Hakone, Ibaraki offers something rarer: genuine experiences that children remember for years. Cycling through five million blue flowers, walking inside a 120-metre bronze statue, watching a real H-II rocket, and standing in front of a tank of sharks. These are not themed attractions — they are encounters with real things on a huge scale, and children respond to them in a way that no theme park can manufacture.

item.title: Ibaraki Leisure: Ushiku Daibutsu, JAXA Space Center & Lake Kasumigaura
item.description: For most international visitors, Ibaraki begins and ends with Hitachi Seaside Park’s blue nemophila fields. That is understandable — the photographs are spectacular — but it leaves most of the prefecture unexplored. Ibaraki is also home to a genuine piece of space history, the world’s tallest bronze Buddha (officially certified by Guinness), Japan’s second-largest lake, one of eastern Japan’s finest aquariums, and a centuries-old pottery town with hands-on workshops. These attractions are spread across the prefecture and vary widely in character, making Ibaraki well suited to a two- or three-day itinerary for visitors who enjoy variety and have access to a car.
